beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Later galleries bring these tensions into family life, work, care, and public institutions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They also challenge Mara’s temptation to turn affected people into evidence for her own position.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The prologue offers both a gradual museum route and an independent final chapter.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For the institutional mystery, begin with The Lamp’s Label and follow the omissions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read to notice how an explanation can remain accurate while making loss disappear.
